rationale.complete: Round 1 done: dated predictions, synthetic validation on real feature matrices (two runs; A1-A2 fixed a day-extrapolation artifact before real data), 27 eligible replication periods, three natives with dated predictions (G26, G35, NE42), both embedding models, estimates rows, and a frozen confirm script dry-run on stand-ins (not run). Missing: a powered convergence test and the holdout.
rationale.faithfulness: The core claim fails: seed features beat the poster + kickoff baseline in 4/27 periods (pooled +0.1 +- 1.6 millinats/idea); poster identity carries most of the forecast skill. A replicated secondary signal survives: long and item-dense seed messages spread each item less (pooled -0.26 +- 0.04 and -0.08 +- 0.03), threaded seeds spread more. Contagiousness vs co-generation is untestable (unread adopters ~1%). Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: One operator rule with numbers: post an item alone, short, and as a reply (-0.24 log-odds per SD of seed length in #51); reply in-degree and reader timing do not predict spread. A first-use forecast is worth computing only in a large regime-III swarm (top-decile lift 2.5 in #51).

one_line: An idea's spread is mostly not forecastable at first use beyond who posted it (4/27 periods); long, item-dense seed messages spread each item less.

models.note: Seed fitness adds held-out skill in 4/27 periods only
